sql: SELECT "budget"."budget_id" AS k, ("budget"."amount" - "budget"."spent") AS m1 FROM "budget" WHERE ("budget"."amount" - "budget"."spent") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.amount budgeted minus amount spent in category
why: amount budgeted - amount spent in category: both in USD and of the same kind (flows) on the same one budget category for one event
rank budget rows by amount budgeted minus amount spent in category

sql: SELECT "budget"."budget_id" AS k, (CAST("budget"."spent" AS REAL) / "budget"."amount") AS m1 FROM "budget" WHERE (CAST("budget"."spent" AS REAL) / "budget"."amount") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.amount spent in category relative to amount budgeted
why: amount spent in category / amount budgeted: a ratio of two quantities in USD
rank budget rows by amount spent in category relative to amount budgeted

sql: SELECT "budget"."budget_id" AS k, (CAST(("budget"."spent" - "budget"."amount") AS REAL) / "budget"."amount") AS m1 FROM "budget" WHERE (CAST(("budget"."spent" - "budget"."amount") AS REAL) / "budget"."amount") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.relative difference of amount spent in category from amount budgeted
why: (amount spent in category - amount budgeted) / amount budgeted: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
rank budget rows by relative difference of amount spent in category from amount budgeted

sql: SELECT "budget"."budget_id" AS k, "budget"."amount" AS m1 FROM "budget" WHERE "budget"."amount" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank budget rows by amount budgeted
